item.name: Blue Extract
item.role: Blue crafting material and blue-pollen boost.
item.commonUses: Crafting equipment and accessories; boosting Blue Pollen.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 50 Blueberries and 10 Royal Jelly; also found in Memory Matches.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 50 Blueberries and 10 Royal Jelly.
item.activeEffect: Grants x1.25 Blue Pollen for 10 minutes.
item.cardSummary: Blue Extract supports blue gear crafting and grants x1.25 Blue Pollen for 10 minutes.

item.name: Red Extract
item.role: Red crafting material and red-pollen boost.
item.commonUses: Crafting equipment and accessories; boosting Red Pollen.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 50 Strawberries and 10 Royal Jelly; also found in Memory Matches.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 50 Strawberries and 10 Royal Jelly.
item.activeEffect: Grants x1.25 Red Pollen for 10 minutes.
item.cardSummary: Red Extract supports red gear crafting and grants x1.25 Red Pollen for 10 minutes.

item.name: Enzymes
item.commonUses: Crafting gear and activating a conversion boost.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 50 Pineapples and 10 Royal Jelly; also found in Memory Matches.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 50 Pineapples and 10 Royal Jelly.
item.activeEffect: Grants +10% Instant Conversion and x1.25 Convert Rate for 10 minutes.
item.cardSummary: Enzymes support gear crafting and boost conversion for 10 minutes.

item.name: Oil
item.commonUses: Crafting items and boosting bee and player movement speed.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 50 Sunflower Seeds and 10 Royal Jelly; also found in Memory Match.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 50 Sunflower Seeds and 10 Royal Jelly.
item.activeEffect: Grants x1.2 Bee and Player Movespeed for 10 minutes.
item.cardSummary: Oil supports crafting and boosts bee and player movement speed for 10 minutes.

item.name: Glue
item.commonUses: Crafting equipment and boosting bee-gather and tool pollen.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 50 Gumdrops and 10 Royal Jelly; some Black Bear quests also award it.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 50 Gumdrops and 10 Royal Jelly.
item.activeEffect: Grants x1.25 Bee Gather Pollen and Tools for 10 minutes.
item.cardSummary: Glue is used for gear crafting and boosts bee-gather and tool pollen for 10 minutes.

item.name: Tropical Drink
item.commonUses: Combining white pollen, conversion, and critical-chance boosts.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 10 Coconuts, 2 Enzymes, and 2 Oil.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 10 Coconuts, 2 Enzymes, and 2 Oil.
item.activeEffect: Grants x1.25 White Pollen, +10% Instant Conversion, and +5% Critical Chance for 10 minutes.
item.cardSummary: Tropical Drink combines white-pollen, conversion, and critical-chance boosts for 10 minutes.

item.name: Gumdrops
item.commonUses: Covering flowers in goo for bonus honey.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 3 Blueberries, 3 Strawberries, and 3 Pineapples.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 3 Blueberries, 3 Strawberries, and 3 Pineapples.
item.activeEffect: Covers flowers in goo; goo grants bonus honey.
item.cardSummary: Gumdrops cover flowers in goo, which grants bonus honey.

item.name: Moon Charm
item.commonUses: Generating Moon Amulets and crafting Glitter and the Helmet.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 5 Pineapples, 5 Gumdrops, and 1 Royal Jelly.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 5 Pineapples, 5 Gumdrops, and 1 Royal Jelly.
item.activeEffect: Increases bond with a bee by 250.
item.cardSummary: Moon Charm increases bee bond and feeds Moon Amulet, Glitter, and Helmet crafting.

item.name: Glitter
item.commonUses: Boosting the field where it is used and crafting equipment.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 25 Moon Charms and 1 Magic Bean; also found in Memory Matches.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 25 Moon Charms and 1 Magic Bean.
item.activeEffect: Boosts the current field by +100% pollen for 15 minutes.
item.cardSummary: Glitter boosts the current field by +100% pollen for 15 minutes.

item.name: Star Jelly
item.commonUses: Turning a bee into a random gifted bee.
item.source: Earned from named bear quests, challenge rewards, bosses, planters, and Memory Matches.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Used on a bee to reroll it into a random gifted bee.
item.activeEffect: Turns a bee into a random gifted bee.
item.cardSummary: Star Jelly rerolls a bee into a random gifted bee.

item.name: Purple Potion
item.commonUses: Combining improved red, blue, and glue effects with a capacity boost.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 3 Red Extracts, 3 Blue Extracts, and 3 Glue.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 3 Red Extracts, 3 Blue Extracts, and 3 Glue.
item.activeEffect: Grants x1.25 Capacity and improved Red Extract, Blue Extract, and Glue boosts for 15 minutes.
item.cardSummary: Purple Potion combines capacity, color, and glue boosts for 15 minutes.

item.name: Super Smoothie
item.commonUses: Combining improved boosts from several consumables.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 3 Neonberries, 3 Star Jelly, and 3 Purple Potions.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 3 Neonberries, 3 Star Jelly, and 3 Purple Potions.
item.activeEffect: Combines improved consumable boosts for 20 minutes.
item.cardSummary: Super Smoothie combines improved consumable boosts for 20 minutes.

item.name: Soft Wax
item.commonUses: Slightly improving a beequip.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 5 Honeysuckle, 1 Oil, and 1 Enzymes.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 5 Honeysuckle, 1 Oil, and 1 Enzymes.
item.activeEffect: Has a 100% chance to slightly improve a beequip.
item.cardSummary: Soft Wax slightly improves a beequip with a 100% chance.

item.name: Hard Wax
item.commonUses: Improving a beequip.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 3 Soft Wax, 3 Enzymes, and 33 Bitterberries.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 3 Soft Wax, 3 Enzymes, and 33 Bitterberries.
item.activeEffect: Has a 60% chance to improve a beequip.
item.cardSummary: Hard Wax has a 60% chance to improve a beequip.

item.name: Caustic Wax
item.commonUses: Attempting a major beequip improvement at a risk of destruction.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 5 Hard Wax, 5 Enzymes, and 25 Neonberries.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 5 Hard Wax, 5 Enzymes, and 25 Neonberries.
item.activeEffect: Has a 25% chance to greatly improve a beequip and a 75% chance to destroy it.
item.cardSummary: Caustic Wax can greatly improve a beequip, but it can also destroy it.

item.name: Debug Wax
item.commonUses: Greatly improving a beequip.
item.source: Listed as a Beesmas quest reward; no current direct route is listed.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Cannot be crafted.
item.activeEffect: Has a 100% chance to greatly improve a beequip.
item.cardSummary: Debug Wax greatly improves a beequip and cannot be crafted.

item.name: Swirled Wax
item.commonUses: Rerolling a beequip's generated stats.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 3 Hard Wax, 9 Soft Wax, and 6 Purple Potions.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 3 Hard Wax, 9 Soft Wax, and 6 Purple Potions.
item.activeEffect: Rerolls the generated stats of a beequip.
item.cardSummary: Swirled Wax rerolls a beequip's generated stats.

item.name: Broken Drive
item.commonUses: Starting the Robo Bear repair route.
item.source: Found behind the Robo Pass Dispensers in the 30 Bee Zone.
item.recipeOrRequirement: The repair quest replaces it with a White Drive.
item.activeEffect: Starts Robo Bear repair progression and provides no normal color boost.
item.cardSummary: Broken Drive starts Robo Bear repair progression.

item.name: White Drive
item.commonUses: Boosting white pollen, capacity, and colorless bee attack in challenge rounds.
item.source: Purchased from Robo Bear's shop with Cogs and Honey.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Robo Bear shop route uses Cogs and Honey.
item.activeEffect: +25% White Pollen, +25% Capacity, and +1 Colorless Bee Attack during Robo Bear Challenge rounds.
item.cardSummary: White Drive boosts white pollen, capacity, and colorless bee attack in Robo Bear Challenge rounds.

item.name: Red Drive
item.commonUses: Boosting red pollen, capacity, and red bee attack in challenge rounds.
item.source: Earned through Panda Bear's Robo Bear progression route and related challenge rewards.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Earned through Panda Bear's Robo Bear progression and related challenge rewards.
item.activeEffect: +25% Red Pollen, +25% Capacity, and +1 Red Bee Attack during Robo Bear Challenge rounds.
item.cardSummary: Red Drive boosts red pollen, capacity, and red bee attack in Robo Bear Challenge rounds.

item.name: Blue Drive
item.commonUses: Boosting blue pollen, capacity, and blue bee attack in challenge rounds.
item.source: Earned through Dapper Bear's Robo Bear progression route and related challenge rewards.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Earned through Dapper Bear's Robo Bear progression and related challenge rewards.
item.activeEffect: +25% Blue Pollen, +25% Capacity, and +1 Blue Bee Attack during Robo Bear Challenge rounds.
item.cardSummary: Blue Drive boosts blue pollen, capacity, and blue bee attack in Robo Bear Challenge rounds.

item.name: Glitched Drive
item.commonUses: Boosting pollen, capacity, and bee attack in challenge rounds.
item.source: Purchased from Robo Bear's shop after the Gold Cog Amulet route and earned from late challenge or Science Bear progression.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Robo Bear shop route uses Cogs, one of each color drive, and Honey; late challenge and quest routes also apply.
item.activeEffect: +25% Pollen, +25% Capacity, and +1 Bee Attack during Robo Bear Challenge rounds.
item.cardSummary: Glitched Drive boosts pollen, capacity, and bee attack in Robo Bear Challenge rounds.

item.name: Royal Jelly
item.commonUses: Rerolling bees into higher-rarity, gifted, or mutated results.
item.source: Found around the map, from quests, shops, dispensers, and other reward routes.
item.activeEffect: Rerolls a bee into a Rare, Epic, Legendary, or Mythic result, with gifted and mutated variants possible.
item.cardSummary: Royal Jelly rerolls a bee into a higher-rarity, gifted, or mutated result.

item.name: Stinger
item.role: Bee attack boost and crafting material.
item.commonUses: Boosting bee attack and crafting advanced equipment.
item.source: Always awarded by Rogue Vicious Bee and sometimes dropped by Aphids, Scorpions, or Spiders.
item.activeEffect: Grants bees x1.5 attack for 30 seconds.
item.cardSummary: Stinger boosts bee attack for 30 seconds and supports advanced crafting.

item.name: Spirit Petal
item.commonUses: Crafting the Petal Wand and Petal Belt.
item.source: Earned through Spirit Bear's progression.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Used to craft the Petal Wand and Petal Belt.
item.activeEffect: A crafting petal used in late-game equipment routes.
item.cardSummary: Spirit Petal is used to craft the Petal Wand and Petal Belt.

item.name: Turpentine
item.commonUses: Removing waxes from a beequip.
item.source: Crafted in the Blender from 10 Super Smoothies, 10 Caustic Wax, and 100 Star Jelly.
item.recipeOrRequirement: Blender recipe: 10 Super Smoothies, 10 Caustic Wax, and 100 Star Jelly.
item.activeEffect: Removes all waxes from a bee's beequip.
item.cardSummary: Turpentine removes all waxes from a beequip.
